english.title: Driving licence holder fail to surrender for change of name and address
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a driving licence in which your

(A)_[name]_
(B)_[address]_
(C)_[name and address]_

as specified therein ceased to be correct, failed without reasonable excuse to surrender forthwith the

(D)_[licence]_
(E)_[licence and its counterpart]_

to The Secretary of State and provide him with particulars of the alterations failing to be made to the said

(F)_[name]_
(G)_[address]_
(H)_[name and address]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 99(5) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The option 'licence and its counterpart' relates to licences which came into force on or after 1.6.1990 (1.1.1991 in the case of licence granted under the law of Northern Ireland). the counterpart details endorsements and provisional entitlements.
(ii) See also offence wording: H56 for the related offence wording re provisional licence holders.
(iii) See H3316 for the offence wording re failure to surrender 'old' HGV /PSV licence for above purpose and replacement by an LGV/PCV .
(iv) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who was the holder of a driving licence in which the

(A)_[name]_
(B)_[address]_
(C)_[name and address]_

shown had ceased to be correct, failed to surrender the

(D)_[licence]_
(E)_[licence and its counterpart]_

to the Secretary of State and provide details of the required alterations.

(A)_[enw]_

(C)_[enw a'ch cyfeiriad]_

(A)_[yr enw]_
(B)_[y cyfeiriad]_
